author: drbbton
releaseNotes:
1.1.0 - Test speech now button, plus diagnostics for silent announcements. Each selected speaker is listed with its last-activity time and flagged in red when it has never reported or has been quiet for days, which is the usual reason an announcement is silent. The app page also shows the last announcement, its text, and which command was used per speaker. Speech volume now defaults to 35 (0 = do not touch the volume).

1.0.1 - select Sonos by MusicPlayer capability; unified speech dispatch.

1.0.0 - initial release.
